newsitem.title: USA: American Biltrite stake held by investor.
newsitem.headline: American Biltrite stake held by investor.

text.p: New York investor Marvin Schwartz said on Tuesday he holds a 5.48 percent stake or 198,800 common shares in American Biltrite Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Schwartz, a principal at broker-dealer Neuberger & Berman LLC, said the stake was purchased between October 7 and December 4 for $3.56 million.
He said the latest transactions include 28,700 shares bought between October 14 and December 4 at prices ranging from $20.3375 to $22.50 a share.
The stake was purchased for investment, Schwartz said.
American Biltrite is a Wellesley Hills, Ma. based diversified homebuilding products company.
